description: Land Acquisition - Gangodawila, Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1505/6 of 09.07.2007 by Pannala D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes.
